result.rationale: The diff confirms the mechanism: blacklistedGuestEmails are lowercased (line 71: `.map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`) but the filter compares `guest === attendee.email` and `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` without normalizing `guest`, so 'Foo@Example.com' bypasses both the existing-attendee check and the blacklist. The schema only validates z.string().email() which is case-permissive. Real correctness/security defect in the new handler.
